Required resource bundles R-COMPQ R-CRSP-MONTH R-COMP-CRSP-LINK R-INDUSTRY-PEERS; candidate live fields and unresolved semantic/date mapping are recorded on those requirements.

Return: Buy-and-hold raw stock returns during quarter t. Source formula: Quarterly buy-and-hold raw stock return.. Required resource bundles R-COMPQ R-CRSP-MONTH R-COMP-CRSP-LINK R-INDUSTRY-PEERS; candidate live fields and unresolved semantic/date mapping are recorded on those requirements.

Firm stock return: Daily stock return for an acquisition participant (acquirer or target) used to estimate market-model parameters for announcement CARs. Source formula: not reported as a closed formula in the paper. Required resource bundles R-CRSP-DAILY R-CRSP-INDEX R-SDC-CRSP-LINK; candidate live fields and unresolved semantic/date mapping are recorded on those requirements.

CRSP value-weighted return: CRSP value-weighted market return used as the market-model return input. Source formula: not reported as a closed formula in the paper. Required resource bundles R-CRSP-DAILY R-CRSP-INDEX R-SDC-CRSP-LINK; candidate live fields and unresolved semantic/date mapping are recorded on those requirements.

Daily stock return: Target firm daily stock return. Source formula: not reported as a closed formula in the paper. Required resource bundles R-CRSP-DAILY R-CRSP-INDEX R-SDC-CRSP-LINK; candidate live fields and unresolved semantic/date mapping are recorded on those requirements.

Daily market return: Daily market return used as the regressor in the target return-synchronicity regression. Source formula: not reported as a closed formula in the paper. Required resource bundles R-CRSP-DAILY R-CRSP-INDEX R-SDC-CRSP-LINK; candidate live fields and unresolved semantic/date mapping are recorded on those requirements.

ACQ_CAR: Acquirer three-day cumulative abnormal return centered on announcement days −1 to +1. Abnormal returns use the market model with CRSP value-weighted returns; parameters are estimated over event days −205 to −6. Source formula: Three-day cumulative abnormal return over event days [−1,+1] using market-model returns; estimation window [−205,−6].. Required resource bundles R-CRSP-DAILY R-CRSP-INDEX R-SDC-CRSP-LINK; candidate live fields and unresolved semantic/date mapping are recorded on those requirements.

TRG_COMPRNK: Target firm financial statement comparability for t−1. Firm-pair comparability is the negative of the average absolute difference between predicted earnings from the two firm-specific accounting systems applied to the same target-firm returns; the target score averages this across all other firms in the same two-digit SIC industry. TRG_COMP is ranked into deciles 0–9 and divided by nine to form TRG_COMPRNK on [0,1]. Source formula: TRG_COMPRNK_{i,t−1} = DecileRank_{0..9}(TRG_COMP_{i,t−1}) / 9; TRG_COMP_{i,t−1} = mean_{j in same SIC2, j≠i}[-mean_t |E(Earnings^i_i,t) − E(Earnings^i_j,t)|].. Required resource bundles R-COMPQ R-CRSP-MONTH R-COMP-CRSP-LINK R-INDUSTRY-PEERS; candidate live fields and unresolved semantic/date mapping are recorded on those requirements.

ACQ_SIZE: Acquirer size, measured as the natural logarithm of acquirer market value at the end of the quarter before the announcement. Source formula: ln(acquirer market value at prior-quarter end).. Required resource bundles R-CRSP-MONTH R-SDC-CRSP-LINK; candidate live fields and unresolved semantic/date mapping are recorded on those requirements.

ACQ_LEV: Acquirer pre-acquisition leverage: long-term plus short-term debt divided by total assets at fiscal year-end before the acquisition announcement. Required resource bundles R-COMPANNUAL R-CRSP-MONTH R-COMP-CRSP-LINK R-SDC-CRSP-LINK; candidate live fields and unresolved semantic/date mapping are recorded on those requirements.

Required resource bundles R-COMPANNUAL R-CRSP-MONTH R-COMP-CRSP-LINK R-SDC-CRSP-LINK; candidate live fields and unresolved semantic/date mapping are recorded on those requirements.

ACQ_ROA: Acquirer ROA for the year ended before the announcement year, calculated as operating income before depreciation divided by average total assets. Required resource bundles R-COMPANNUAL R-CRSP-MONTH R-COMP-CRSP-LINK R-SDC-CRSP-LINK; candidate live fields and unresolved semantic/date mapping are recorded on those requirements.

design_coverage.reason: The baseline Table 3 regressions do not report fixed-effect families; supporting comparability is estimated separately by firm and industry peers are formed by 2-digit SIC rather than absorbed fixed effects.
The baseline note reports robust standard errors but no clustered standard-error family.
No regression weights are reported. SYNERGY value-weights CARs only in the outcome construction; this fit does not use that outcome.

implementation_issues.description: The source describes the firm-specific quarterly earnings-on-returns and daily synchronicity regressions but does not identify their within-firm estimators; their coefficients/adjusted R² cannot be reproduced from the source specification alone.
The source names the market model and estimation/event windows but does not state its estimator, intercept treatment, or minimum usable event-window observations.

The acquirer Tobin-Q dummy is coded as below-median in the research-design text and above-median in the appendix; the target-size and target-Tobin variable labels also conflict with appendix formulas that specify acquirer market-value inputs.
The source does not identify exact date-valid SDC-to-CRSP/Compustat participant link rules, Thomson 13F position-date treatment or the institutional-holder aggregation rule for BLOCK.

review_notes: The frozen three baseline Table 3 result sets are retained separately (ACQ_CAR N=1,307; SYNERGY N=1,277; ΔROA N=1,042). ΔROA: Change in acquirer benchmark-adjusted ROA: average over years t+1 through t+3 after acquisition completion minus average over t−1 through t−3 before completion. Benchmark-adjusted ROA subtracts the median ROA of matched firms in the same two-digit SIC with ROA between 80% and 120% of the acquirer’s ROA one year before the announcement year. Source formula: mean(benchmark-adjusted ROA_{t+1,t+2,t+3}) − mean(benchmark-adjusted ROA_{t−1,t−2,t−3}); benchmark-adjusted ROA = acquirer ROA − median matched-peer ROA.. Required resource bundles R-COMP-DELTA-ROA R-SDC-MA R-COMP-CRSP-LINK R-INDUSTRY-PEERS; candidate live fields and unresolved semantic/date mapping are recorded on those requirements.

TRG_COMPRNK: Target firm financial statement comparability for t−1. Firm-pair comparability is the negative of the average absolute difference between predicted earnings from the two firm-specific accounting systems applied to the same target-firm returns; the target score averages this across all other firms in the same two-digit SIC industry. TRG_COMP is ranked into deciles 0–9 and divided by nine to form TRG_COMPRNK on [0,1]. Source formula: TRG_COMPRNK_{i,t−1} = DecileRank_{0..9}(TRG_COMP_{i,t−1}) / 9; TRG_COMP_{i,t−1} = mean_{j in same SIC2, j≠i}[-mean_t |E(Earnings^i_i,t) − E(Earnings^i_j,t)|].. Required resource bundles R-COMPQ R-CRSP-MONTH R-COMP-CRSP-LINK R-INDUSTRY-PEERS; candidate live fields and unresolved semantic/date mapping are recorded on those requirements.

evidence.description: The original U.S. announcement-date acquisition universe starts in 1983 and ends in 2009; selected completed deals have public bidder and target firms.
The study excludes repurchases and retains completed SDC M, AM or AA deals meeting the stated value and acquirer-size thresholds.
Three-day announcement CARs use event days −1 to +1 and CRSP value-weighted market-model parameters estimated from the earlier pre-announcement window ending at day −6.
Target comparability uses firm-specific quarterly earnings-on-returns accounting systems estimated over sixteen pre-announcement quarters, with a fourteen-quarter minimum.
Post-acquisition operating performance compares three-year pre- and post-period mean benchmark-adjusted ROA, with the source defining t by completion year.
The blockholder indicator is based on institutional ownership of more than five percent of target shares; the paper does not name a source table or position-date rule.
The research-design text codes the acquirer Tobin-Q dummy as one below the sample median.
The appendix gives the opposite direction for the same acquirer dummy.
The appendix labels target size and target Tobin-Q but describes acquirer market value inputs, leaving referents unresolved.
